import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
exp = df.iloc[10:22]  # expense rows (Excel 11-22)
exp.columns = ['category','item','amount']
exp['amount'] = pd.to_numeric(exp['amount'])
total = exp['amount'].sum()
print('Per-category totals:')
print(exp.groupby('category', sort=False)['amount'].sum().to_string())
print()
print(f'TOTAL EXPENSES: {total:,.2f}')
print()
print('Formula in C23:', '=SUM(C11:C22)')
print('Formula range sum:', exp['amount'].sum())
"
